title: Spec
description: What has to be true when the work is done, independent of how it is built.

goal.description: The outcome in one or two sentences, from the user's point of view.

acceptance.description: Testable criteria; each one can be checked as met or not met.

out_of_scope.description: Things a reader might expect that this work deliberately excludes.

constraints.description: Limits the solution must respect (compatibility, performance, platforms, deadlines).

affected_areas.description: Parts of the codebase the work will likely touch.

evidence.description: path:line showing why it is affected.

assumptions.description: Gaps you filled in yourself; each one is a question someone may want to overrule.

open_questions.description: Decisions that block a correct spec and need an answer.
